subject: Sprinter 144-inch high-roof exterior with camper glazing, sleeping flares, running gear, hood lip, roof rack, front light bar, motorcycle carrier and 2021 KTM 350 SX-F
method: Original polygon reconstruction from supplied reference renders; not a scan or factory CAD

wheelbase.evidence: Owner chassis identification; 144-inch high-roof configuration also visible in supplied manufacturer-page screenshot.

nominalBodyLength.evidence: Scale target consistent with supplied manufacturer-page screenshot. Screenshot is model year 2026, not a chassis-specific 2023 source; front and rear overhangs are scaled to this nominal envelope while preserving axle spacing.

widthWithMirrors.evidence: Scale target from the 2026 reference screenshot, not chassis-specific verification.

bodyWidthWithoutMirrors.evidence: Bare cargo-shell proportion estimate; replaces the former 82-inch camper-envelope assumption.

roofToGround.evidence: Current model ground plane follows the photo-estimated hub position and nominal tire radius. This is not a measured overall vehicle height; rack, suspension load and terrain are unverified.

lengthWithCarrier.evidence: Digital combined envelope from nominal shell front to modeled rear tie-down tube. Receiver location and insertion depth are unmeasured; not an installed-vehicle measurement.

registration: Owner 60 × 122-inch track-referenced planning rectangle has photo-estimated body origin [0, 26, 0]. First/last modeled crossbars align with its front/rear. Saved item coordinates remain relative to the planning origin. Physical endpoints and body registration are unverified.
scope: Exterior with sleeping flares, side/rear camper windows, running gear, hood lip, open roof rack with front LED bar, estimated receiver, HAUL-MASTER 57720 carrier and 2021 KTM 350 SX-F. Awning, ladders, spare-tire carrier and interior remain deferred.
uncertainty: No dimensional tolerance established. All unmeasured contours, seams, glazing, tires, lamps and stance are estimates. Do not derive mounting positions or usable clearance from shell surfaces.
license: Original model geometry and code: MIT. Supplied reference imagery and manufacturer trademarks are not relicensed.

bodyPaint.description: Blue-gray with an additional small blue shift at owner request
bodyPaint.evidence: Compared actual driver/passenger WebGL views with owner photographs. Appearance estimate under studio lighting, not a calibrated color or factory paint code.

verification.method: Five orthographic reference/render overlays using uniform scale and translation, plus two oblique rendered views and independent agent review. Reference imagery remains private. The flare/glazing revision also uses two local owner-photo/render overlays with uniform scale and translation based on body seams, rear body line and gutter. Camera perspective remains unmatched; these overlays are visual checks only.
verification.meaning: Mesh continuity and software scale checks only. They do not establish physical accuracy or a manufacturing tolerance.
verification.remainingDifferences: Fine grille and lamp relief, body contours, suspension mounts, rim brand/profile, tread and sidewall details remain approximate. Actual suspension lift and physical tolerances are unverified.
verification.cabBrow: Compared supplied side/quarter reference pixels and owner passenger photo with actual rendered before/after views and a fixed-registration 50% side overlay. Broadened longitudinal bow recovery and transverse crown blending to remove the artificial inward S curve above the windshield; no dimensional tolerance is inferred.
verification.cabBrowMeshCheck: Eleven longitudinal sections across the rendered roof brow have no inward slope reversal through the transition immediately above the windshield. The central windshield upper-edge elevation remains level.
verification.roofRackAndHood: Actual front, side, oblique, overhead and close-up renders compared with owner photos. Private front hood/light-bar overlays use local scale and translation; no calibrated physical tolerance. Independent reviewer confirmed lowered front crown, legible front mark and seated hood lip; no blocking visual regression. Mobile Chrome emulation at 375 × 844 checked 3D, Front and Top views; desktop rack visibility and roof planning remain operational.

fullSceneGeometry.scope: Shell with camper glazing, flares, running gear, hood lip, rack, receiver, carrier and motorcycle; editable roof equipment not included in this count.

sleepingFlares.evidence: Owner driver/passenger/rear photos inspected in pixels and compared with rendered overlays. Passenger forward edge is adjacent to the sliding-door rear seam. Small driver window retains its fore/aft position and uses a taller rounded outline. Product photos support a rearward increase in projection; installed product identity and actual dimensions are unverified.
sleepingFlares.limits: Inputs are visual reconstruction estimates; shared body contour transforms affect final bounds. Do not use them for cutting, ordering parts or mounting. Visibility toggle is a view control, not part of roof-layout JSON.

manufacturerComparison.depthDefinition: At the deepest part, per manufacturer. Extended passenger flare is not offered because of sliding-door interference.
manufacturerComparison.application: Footprint and maximum-depth values guide this estimated reconstruction. Front depths, taper angle, placement, corner radii and window dimensions remain photo-based estimates; they are not published specifications for this van.

camperWindows.evidence: Driver-side middle and passenger sliding-door glass outlines inspected in owner photos. Front lower corners are broader; small opening panes sit toward the front. Driver rear edge is partly hidden by the ladder.
camperWindows.limits: Placement and dimensions are visual estimates, not window-cutout measurements. Independent visibility control is separate from roof-layout JSON.

tires.evidence: Owner-maintained vehicle specification identifies this as the installed set. The 265/70R17 option in the record is a future possibility, not current fitment.
tires.dimensionMethod: Designation arithmetic rounded to 0.1 in: 17 + 2 × 245 × 0.70 / 25.4. Actual mounted, inflated and loaded dimensions have not been measured.
tires.geometryStatus: KO3-informed original tread and shoulder approximation; not an exact product mesh

wheels.style: Six forked spokes in satin charcoal
wheels.styleEvidence: Owner front/rear wheel photo crops inspected in pixels
wheels.limits: Width, lip profile, spoke faceting, hub depth and track are visual estimates; no rim brand or exact model is asserted.

suspension.visualReference: Arrow Trail 2500 / Falcon auxiliary shocks and rear leaf packs
suspension.evidence: Local photo ratios give roughly 1.15–1.33 visible rim diameters from hub to arch; the model uses 1.243. Photos cannot separate kit lift from factory AWD stance, loading, terrain and prior model error.
suspension.limits: 4.7 in is solely a correction to the previous generic rendering, NOT a measured or manufacturer-specified suspension lift. Shock dimensions, mounts, springs and axle hardware are illustrative; this is not a suspension travel or interference model.

verification.method: Three private photo/render comparisons registered by wheel hub and visible rim diameter with uniform scaling only; perspective and uneven terrain remain unmatched.

rearWindows.evidence: Owner rear photograph inspected in pixels; two broad tinted panes with rounded outer corners nearly meet at the door seam. Lower edge raised after comparing the painted gap above the rear badge. Lower outer areas are partly occluded; no cutout measurements.

configuration.ramp: stored on vehicle side of channel

motorcycleCarrier.limits: Installation coordinates, tube walls, mount brackets and fine details are estimates. Product capacity is not a vehicle/hitch load assessment. No clearance or mounting validation.
motorcycleCarrier.identification: Matches owner-described Harbor Freight 600 lb carrier and visible photo structure. Exact production revision is unconfirmed.

motorcycle.sourceDescription: KTM owner manual 3214215en, 07/2020, printed pages 139–140; manufacturer-authored manual hosted by a third party.

appearance.details: Orange/white plastics, black seat, black spoked rims, knobby tires, silver right-side silencer and front number 69 from owner photos. Fine graphics, engine, controls, tire profiles and unseen side are reconstructed.

motorcycle.limits: Nominal tire diameters are calculated from stock size codes, not measured knobby-tire envelopes. Installation, steering, tie-down paths and transport stance are estimates. No load, restraint, door-opening or clearance validation.
motorcycle.geometryLicense: Original MIT-licensed reconstruction. No third-party meshes, photo textures or manual pages distributed.

hoodDeflector.description: Black tapered hood leading-edge lip with shallow raised ridge, from owner front photo
hoodDeflector.verification: Private front-photo/render overlay with uniform scaling and translation; close-up inspected for surface contact. Camera perspective and dimensions uncalibrated.

roofRack.description: Open two-level roof rack with sloping front/rear fairings and front LED bar
roofRack.sourceScope: Entegra lists double roof rack and front/rear wind deflectors with front LED light bar. This source does not establish dimensions or hardware manufacturer.
unresolved: Whether the 6.5-inch observation reaches the crossbar top, center or bottom
Identity of top rail in the separate 4-inch observation
Exact rail sections, hidden crossbars, mounting feet and light-bar model
roofRack.limits: Photo-estimated registration and hardware. 6.5 inches is used only as an illustrative crossbar-top elevation, not a resolved measurement datum. The separate 4-inch observation is not used to solve heights. Hidden beams are not inferred. No load, mounting or equipment-clearance validation.
roofRack.coordinateFrame: Body coordinates: X passengerward, Y rearward, Z up; units inches.
roofRack.geometryLicense: Original MIT geometry. No photo textures, manufacturer drawings or third-party mesh redistributed.
